verdict.rationale: Poke's own API lets scripts, automation tools and CI/CD pipelines send messages to and trigger Poke programmatically, so it can be driven headlessly from CI. The evidence only covers one-way message triggering, plus a CLI used for login and MCP tunneling; it does not show a full non-interactive agent run in a pipeline. missing for 10: documented headless/CI execution mode returning results to the pipeline, non-interactive auth/token setup for CI, OpenAPI spec (probes 404), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Poke API allows you to send messages programmatically from your applications, scripts, and automation tools.
Services like GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, or monitoring tools can trigger Poke when something happens.
